name: superra
description: superRA skills for disciplined research-assistant workflows in Codex.
author: Zhiyu Fu

interface.longDescription: superRA adds plan, execution, review, integration, and merge discipline plus Codex lifecycle hook reminders for research-oriented coding workflows. Install the shared skills from the superRA marketplace entry; dispatched agents pick up their implementer or reviewer role by loading the matching skill, so there is nothing further to install.
